name: 9709-imageprefill-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1 -- single GPU is part of the declaration and must not be raised
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16 -- as declared by the checkpoint's own config.json
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 512 requests with a 1800 s safety cap
workload: guidellm over /v1/chat/completions, single turn: 128 tokens of synthetic text and one 1280x720 JPEG at quality 85 of random noise, randomized per row so every request carries a byte-different picture. ~1330 tokens in, 1196 of them the picture, 128 out with ignore_eos.
purpose: A 7B image-and-text assistant answering one 720p photo plus a short question for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- the parser DROPS nested blocks, and a dropped block means the engine
# runs without something this file declares. Environment variables cannot live here; the one this
# setup needs is in configs/tuned.yaml, which is the wired path for them.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
enable-multimodal: true
chat-template: qwen2-vl
mem-fraction-static: 0.8
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
max-prefill-tokens: 8192
disable-radix-cache: true
